scenarios.scenario-1: A tree with several projects (nested and sibling) is discovered by docs/graph-index.xml markers; each row reports counts, lint errors/warnings, coverage and clean/findings status, with correct totals.
scenarios.scenario-2: Depth bounds and ignoreDirs are honoured; a scan beyond the cap reports truncated instead of hanging; --files-free read-only run never writes.
scenarios.scenario-3: Exit codes: 0 when every project is clean, 1 when any project has errors, --strict promotes warnings, 2 on usage/config errors; JSON exposes per-project summaries and totals.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text/JSON output is asserted by the tests; library paths emit no runtime log markers.

notes.note-1: Covered by test/grace-projects.test.ts (discovery, depth/ignore rules, cap/truncation, per-project summary, strict exit promotion, JSON envelope).
notes.note-2: On this repository it reports three projects: MyGRACE, DemoStore (examples/demo-store) and TestProject (test/fixtures/mygrace-project).
